slides.texte_overlay:
Small acts of kindness
that make men unforgettable
Carrying something for a stranger. A heavy suitcase up the metro stairs, a pram on the bus. Ten seconds of help that someone will remember for the whole day.
Paying for the coffee of the person behind you. Once in a while, for no reason. A small surprise that turns a stranger's ordinary morning into a good story.
Remembering the barista's name. "Morning, Sofia." People who serve others all day rarely hear their names. It makes them feel seen, and it costs you nothing.
Checking on the friend who went quiet. "Haven't heard from you in a while, you okay?" Sometimes that one message arrives on the exact day someone needs it most.
Before: kindness felt awkward, I never knew what to say. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a curiosity that makes talking to anyone easy.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: kindness felt awkward, I never knew what to say. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. Now talking to anyone is easy.

slides.texte_overlay: Giving a sincere compliment to someone's parent. "Your son is one of the most reliable guys I know." Parents never forget hearing good things about their kids.
Leaving a kind review for a small business. The local barber, the family restaurant, the repair shop. A few words online can make an owner's whole week.
